# Workflow Station Guidelines (English bundle)

Portal: /help/. Audience: designers. Not source code.

## Computed field formulas (/help/computed-fields)

A computed column fills itself. People cannot type into it on forms. Save uses the server formula engine. Formula dialog Calculate is preview only.

Order: open Table Design and the table → tick Computed → open Formula → save the table.

Screenshot table: Purchase Request, help_pr. Computed: window_days, line_count, grand_total, over_budget. Sub-table help_pr_line has line_total = quantity * unit_price.

Samples:
- This row: quantity * unit_price
- Related rows (main table only): SUM(help_pr_line.line_total), COUNT(help_pr_line)
- Sub-table reads main: help_pr.request_title (column must not itself be computed; do not wrap in SUM)
- Dates: end_date - start_date ; DATEDIFF(start_date, end_date)
- Logic: IF(grand_total > 5000, "Y", "N")

Result type must match Data Type. Fail: block save shows #ERR; leave blank saves the rest of the form with this column empty.

Admin Relation Tables are standalone: no MAIN/SUB lookup, no SUM related-row functions. See /help/computed-fields#relation.

## Send email (/help/email-send)

Three pieces: Outbound connection, Email Template, Send Task. Subject and body live on the template, not the node.

Order: Outbound connection → template (enabled) → Send Task → To + Connection + Template → save.

SMTP host/port/TLS come from Admin Center → System Config. Same email cannot have two connections in the same direction.

Template example: PR Approved Notice. Insert Variable for main fields, lookup attributes, or a sub-table (rendered as a table). Visual and HTML panes; HTML mode keeps <style> tags in the design-time preview. Switching back to Visual may simplify tables and styles.

Send Task required: To, Connection, Template. From override optional. Failures: missing connection, empty To, missing/disabled template, empty subject after variables, attachment not a FILE field, no global SMTP.

Related: /help/email-monitor , /help/computed-fields

## Email Monitor (/help/email-monitor)

Starts a process when mail arrives.

Order: Inbound connection → monitor template → bind sample text to main-table fields → Inbound Email Trigger on Start event → save binding → Deploy.

Do not set From/Subject filters on the template; those belong only on the Start Event. Do not set Process Key on the template.

Examples: template Vendor quote to PR; folder INBOX; extraction to request_title; Subject Filter Quote on StartEvent_Email.

Every enabled monitor template must be bound before Deploy. Bound templates cannot be deleted until unbound.

Related: /help/email-send#connection , /help/computed-fields

## Delegate a task (/help/task-delegate)

You are Current Assignee. Delegate this one open task. You stay the assignee. Someone else can complete it on your behalf.

This is not Transfer (that button still changes the assignee). This is not Setup → Delegations standing rules.

Order: open the task from To Do → click Delegate → choose Specified user or Specified BU and Role → Confirm → the other person opens Delegated on To Do.

Specified user: pick Target User. Extra line Delegated to that person. They see On behalf of you. You can still complete it yourself.

Specified BU and Role: pick Business Unit then Role (both required; Role disabled until a unit is chosen). Visible and completable only when the header workspace is that same pair. Switching workspace hides it. System Administrator does not see every delegated task. No Claim after this kind of delegate.

Unclaimed pool: Delegate is hidden until someone is assigned.

Failures: Please select user; Please select both business unit and role; cannot delegate to yourself; completed tasks cannot be delegated.

## Form events (/help/form-events)

Two places to write scripts: Edit on a selected control, and Form event on the Form tab (button still Edit). Not Table Design Formula.

Sidebar: Form Design → Controls → How to write events. Click a control name under Basic / Extend / MI / Layout / Auxiliary — there is no Event item under each control.

Order: open Form Design → select a control (or open Form tab → Form event) → Edit → Create / pick a name → Save → Ok → save the form.

The Edit dialog has Create on the left and the script editor on the right. Save writes the function you are editing. Ok keeps the list. Footer Cancel discards dialog edits.

Shared names in every control event: $inject, api (same as options), value, field, formData (same snapshot as data), user, option (often empty), rule/self (rarely needed), args (original payload). Always write user && before a property.

Each method on the human page is written as: if you want X, use this; before (designer default); after (what you see). This index keeps method names for lookup.

api (same methods on Form event via api / options):
- getValue(field) / setValue(field, value) / setValue({ field: value, … }) / api.form (read snapshot; do not assign)
- required(true|false, field) / requiredStatus(field)
- disabled(true|false, field) / disabledStatus(field) — whole-form readonly and audit fields stay locked
- hidden(true) removes from page (not submitted); hidden(false) puts back; hiddenStatus — also Card/Tabs/Collapse/Row
- display(true) hides with CSS; display(false) shows; displayStatus is true when shown
- setOptions / addOption / removeOption / clearOptions / resetOptions — Select/Radio/Checkbox only; clearOptions does not clear the field value
- setFieldError / clearFieldError — blocks Save until cleared; beforeSubmit return false also blocks Save
- setFormNotification(message, ERROR|WARNING|INFO, uniqueId) / clearFormNotification — ERROR banner does not block Save
- setLookupFilter / clearLookupFilter / refresh — Lookup only (field is that control’s Field name); AND with designer/cascade; invalid selection auto-clears. No Sub-Table refresh
- setFocus / setLabel / getLabel / resetLabel — labels are plain text
Omit field on hidden/display/required/disabled only to affect every field.

Samples use help_pr / help_pr_line (request_title, requester, scenario, start_date, end_date, cost_center, notes, quantity).

Hooks on every control: hook_load, hook_mounted, hook_deleted, hook_watch, hook_value, hook_hidden, hook_titleClick.

Form event names: onSubmit, onReset, onCreated, onMounted, onReload, onChange, beforeSubmit, beforeFetch. onChange has field, value, options. beforeSubmit can return false to stop Save.

Form Preview has no Portal workspace: activeBusinessUnitName and activeRoleName stay empty until User Portal.

Per-control events: /help/form-events-basic (Basic), /help/form-events-extend (Extend + MI), /help/form-events-layout (Layout + Auxiliary).

Related: /help/computed-fields

## Basic control events (/help/form-events-basic)

Palette Basic. Field controls list their Create events plus blur and focus. Example: Select scenario change → api.required(value === 'A', ['start_date', 'end_date']) on help_pr / help_pr_line. Upload lists remove, preview, error, progress, exceed (not change). Hooks stay on /help/form-events#hooks.

## Extend and MI events (/help/form-events-extend)

Extend: Sub-Table and Link Form keep change/blur/focus. Inline Form, Record Note have click only (no Field). Lookup and Owner have change/blur/focus. MI Assignment Mode: click on the container; put value scripts on child fields.

## Layout and Auxiliary events (/help/form-events-layout)

Usually click plus hooks. Tabs may also list tabClick, tabChange, tabAdd, tabRemove when Create shows those names. Button click can fill requester from user.
